t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the long headed gnomes are better in the opening rounds and the short headed one are better towards the end. Also I should pick orange over green

vb_textbox.text: Pink is worth more than blue. Orange tends to be worth more than green. The pointy head gnomes are worth more than flat head gnomes for the first few rounds. But this changes in the later rounds and the flat head seem to be worth more.
